purpose: Single machine-readable registry of ongoing and historical physical sources relevant to Eastern Shore Jubilee prediction. Discovery is not ingestion. registry_rule: INGESTED requires a successful parser/extractor run, immutable source hash/subset hash where applicable, normalized rows and provenance manifest. Discovery alone never qualifies.

source_interpretation_guardrails.rule: NOAA 8733821 is ASTRONOMICAL_PREDICTION for present-day use. Never emit LIVE/OBSERVED, live-sensor health, observed water-level tendency, or surge residual from this station.

GCOOS DISL_BSPA and DISL_MHPA oxygen are DEPTH_UNKNOWN_OBSERVATION_PROXY with an unresolved ug/L-versus-mg/L metadata conflict. No automatic conversion and no BOTTOM_DO/vertical-gradient/stratification eligibility until native DISL units and deployment geometry are reconciled.
